items.title: All Comers II — Corey Vose and Avery Burton Take the Title
items.body: Labor Day weekend at Hermosa Beach LBC. Corey Vose and Avery Burton won the second annual All Comers Open Pairs. Dean Warmington and Angel Rocha finished second, Michael Siddall and Bill Brault third, and Tom Richeson and Phil Dunn fourth. Full top eight on the Results page.

items.title: Division Shirt Store Closing Saturday, September 12
items.body: Sales for the new Southwest Division shirt close Saturday, September 12 at 10:00 AM PDT. The shirt carries our official Southwest Bowls branding and colors and is made for everyday wear by social and tournament bowlers alike. $27.00 each, made to order. Fit varies between brands, so please don't assume your usual size — lay out a shirt you already like and follow the measuring instructions in the store. Shirts ship free to your home club for pickup; choose your club at checkout and give your home address as well. If your club has fewer than 10 orders, shirts are mailed to your home and you pay the shipping.

items.title: Eileen Morton Powerplay Triples — Susan Trenschel, Tamara Murray and Chris Trenschel Take the Title
items.body: Saturday, August 29 · Santa Barbara LBC. Susan Trenschel, Tamara Murray and Chris Trenschel won the Eileen Morton Powerplay Triples. Tony Santos, Nancy Santos and Rob Humphrey finished second, and Gloria Brown, Jack Bucey and Tim Adkins third. Full podium and photos on the Results page.

items.title: Disciplinary Policy and Procedures — Updated
items.body: The Southwest Division's Disciplinary Policy and Procedures has been amended, effective August 3, 2026. It applies to any claim, complaint, report or investigation opened on or after that date; anything reported earlier stays under the previous policy. Read the full document on the Policies and Procedures page.
